messages:
release-manager: Heads up — staging promotion paused. staging-e2e (matrix/pg12) hung on job 7821, waiting on a DB advisory lock. deploybot auto-promotion has been paused.

deploybot: promotion halted by workflow 'canary-check'. run: deploy/2026-03-21-78. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/7821 — status: hung.

ci-bot: tail(log): "[45m] Waiting for advisory lock id=12345" then repeated sleeps. Process shows `select pg_advisory_lock` blocking, PID 3456. No progress for ~46m.

alex: can we kill the job and rerun the job instead of pinning? last-good image tag: prod-2026-03-20-58. If lock not cleared quickly i'd prefer manual promote to last-good to avoid cutting into release window. :eyes:

morgan: +1 to pin if clearing lock >10m. any DB migration in this deploy that would break a pin?

dina: there's a small additive migration in the canary (adds index concurrently). it's safe to skip temporarily but we should not lose the migration entirely. if we pin, schedule follow-up to run migration or include it in a small hotfix.

jasper: alternative: kill offending process and rerun smoke subset of e2e (smoke-only) against the same image to validate quickly. that avoids skipping the migration in the short term. requires DB lock released.

sre-oncall: investigating now. I can see an ingester pod holding a long-lived connection that acquired advisory lock 12345. pulling process list...

sre-oncall: running kill on process inside pod: `kubectl exec -n staging deploy/ingester -- pkill -f run_ingest` — giving 30s grace then will force. also prepared SQL fallback: `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)` where pid = 54321.

ci-bot: job 7821 reported 'terminated by signal 15' and lock appears freed. starting rerun: staging-e2e smoke subset (tags: smoke, quick).

release-manager: good work. plan: if smoke passes within 12m we continue promotion; if it fails or times out we'll pin to prod-2026-03-20-58 and open a follow-up to run migration + full e2e in a separate window. please add short note to release notes about this intervention.

alex: filing GH issue to add a 2min advisory-lock timeout and a cleanup step to the e2e harness. also will flag the ingester to avoid holding global locks during CI runs.

dina: for release notes: "Canary temporarily blocked by staging DB advisory lock — manual intervention cleared lock and smoke rerun initiated. If rerun fails, promotion will be pinned to last-good image and migration retried in a follow-up release."

jasper: small TODO: add CI label `ci:no-global-locks` and a pretest hook that warns if a test acquires advisory locks.

release-manager: thanks all. marking this thread for postmortem if pinning happens. :thumbsup:
